story_set.title: The Old Order Changeth!
story_set.pencils: Jack Kirby (credited) (layouts); Dick Ayers (credited) (pencils); Carl Hubbell (see notes)
story_set.characters: The Avengers [Captain America [Steve Rogers] (featured); Giant-Man [Hank Pym] (featured) (leaves team); Hawkeye [Clint Barton] (featured) (joins team, also in flashback); Iron Man [Tony Stark] (featured) (leaves team); Quicksilver [Pietro Maximoff] (featured) (joins team); Scarlet Witch [Wanda Maximoff] (featured) (joins team); Thor [Don Blake] (featured) (leaves team); Wasp [Janet Van Dyne] (featured) (leaves team)]; Brotherhood of Evil Mutants [Mastermind [Jason Wyngarde] (flashback) (cameo); Quicksilver [Pietro Maximoff] (flashback) (leaves team); Scarlet Witch [Wanda Maximoff] (flashback) (leaves team); Toad [Mortimer Toynbee] (flashback) (cameo)]; Masters of Evil [Black Knight [Nathan Garrett] (villain) (leaves team); Enchantress [Amora] (villain) (leaves team); The Executioner [Skurge] (villain) (leaves team); Melter [Bruno Horgan] (villain) (leaves team)]; X-Men [Angel [Warren Worthington III] (flashback) (cameo); Beast [Hank McCoy] (flashback) (cameo); Iceman [Bobby Drake] (flashback) (cameo)]; Black Widow [Natasha Romanoff] (flashback) (guest); Elendil; Happy Hogan (guest); Hulk [Bruce Banner] (cameo); Immortus [Nathaniel Richards] (guest); Edwin Jarvis (supporting) (unnamed); Rick Jones (supporting); Erik Josten (villain) (unnamed, as one of Zemo's mercenaries); Kang [Nathaniel Richards] (Other Earth - Earth-6311) (guest); Magneto [Erik Lehnsherr] (flashback) (cameo); Mole Man [Harvey Elder] (guest); Sub-Mariner [Namor] (guest); Bill; communist agents (antagonist, flashback); Atlanteans [unnamed ones] (guest); Zemo's slaves [unnamed ones]; General Curtiss
story_set.synopsis: Most of the old Avengers line-up leaves, leaving Captain America behind to be leading the Scarlet Witch, Hawkeye and Quicksilver.
story_set.notes:
Nick Caputo suspects that Carl Hubbell provided alterations on several figures throughout the story, particularly on pages 5, 10, 17 and 20, per his blog:

http://nick-caputo.blogspot.com/2014/06/the-unknown-art-of-carl-hubbell.html

The episode title might be inspired by A. Tennyson’s poem Idylls of the King, The Passing of Arthur (1869): "The old order changeth, yielding place to new."
